annotations.title: Get public holidays and bridge days

description: Returns the official public holidays of one year for Germany, Spain or the United Kingdom — the whole country, or one region of it: a German Land (Bayern, Hessen, NRW…), a Spanish comunidad, Madrid or Barcelona (with their municipal days), or a UK nation (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland). Each date says where it applies, so a day off only in part of a region (Augsburg, an island) is never presented as a day off for everyone. Also returns the best bridge days (leave days to take for the longest run of consecutive days off) and the working days of the year. Use it before planning an office move, a team offsite, a booking or a lease start around holidays, instead of recalling the calendar from memory: regional days differ by state and town.

country.description: ISO country code: 'DE' Germany, 'ES' Spain, 'GB' the United Kingdom.

region.description: Optional region: a code ('BY', 'HE', 'MD', 'CT', 'SCT'), a name ('Bayern', 'Nordrhein-Westfalen', 'NRW', 'Andalucía', 'Scotland') or a city with its own calendar ('Madrid', 'Barcelona'). Omit for the days the whole country shares.

year.description: Calendar year. Only years with official data are served: 2026, 2027. Defaults to the latest.
